description: Plan a multi-store shopping trip near a location, picking the best products across configured Swiss grocery chains. Items can be generic ("milch", "pasta") or pinned to a specific SKU. Returns a primary plan plus alternatives. Use when the user gives a list of items and asks "where should I shop?" or "what's cheapest?". Strategies: single_store (one chain), split_cart (multi-chain with stop penalty), absolute_cheapest (no penalty).

inputSchema.description: Plan a multi-store shopping trip near a location, picking the best products across configured Swiss grocery chains. Items can be generic ("milch", "pasta") or pinned to a specific SKU. Returns a primary plan plus alternatives. Use when the user gives a list of items and asks "where should I shop?" or "what's cheapest?". Strategies: single_store (one chain), split_cart (multi-chain with stop penalty), absolute_cheapest (no penalty).

chains.description: Restrict the plan to these chains. Omit to consider all configured chains.

items.description: The list of items to shop for. At least one item required.
A single item in the shopping list.

filters.description: Optional product constraints applied when searching for this item.

maxPrice.description: Reject products above this CHF price per unit.

sizeRange.description: Size range filter in millilitres; useful for beverages.

tags.description: Require all listed tags on matching products, e.g. ["organic", "vegan"].

preferredChain.description: Prefer this chain for this item when scores are tied. Useful for loyalty card preferences.

preferredProductId.description: Pin a specific product by chain + ID. If set, query is ignored for product selection.

chain.description: Chain the pinned product belongs to.

id.description: Exact product ID to use for this line item; bypasses search.

quantity.description: Number of units needed (default 1). Used for total cost calculation.

query.description: Product search term, e.g. "Milch", "pasta integrale". The planner searches this across chains.

anyOf.description: GPS coordinates of the shopper's location
Free-text address — geocoded via Nominatim; prefer zip or lat/lng for speed

address.description: Free-text address string — geocoded via OpenStreetMap Nominatim; prefer zip or lat/lng for speed.

near.description: Shopper's location — used to find nearby stores. Pass coordinates, ZIP, or address.

radiusKm.description: Only consider stores within this radius of the provided location (1–50 km). Default 5 km.

splitPenaltyChf.description: Cost in CHF added per extra store stop in split_cart strategy. Default 2.00.

strategy.description: single_store: buy everything at one chain (minimises trips). split_cart: allow multiple chains but add splitPenaltyChf per extra stop. absolute_cheapest: pick the cheapest source per item regardless of stops.

name: plan_shopping
